walkthrough: Goal: week 2's colour work, the way V大's 临摹色彩组合 asks: copy a small abstract picture of a few colour areas by eye (its overall tone first, then the middle tones by colour, then the hierarchy and the edges; never picked from the original), and see area by area how my colours differ and whether I made a weak contrast strong; paint a value scale between a given dark and light in even steps; and keep a long colour copy (色彩临摹, 大作业) beside the sessions, worked on whenever I like.

Entry: in the gallery the Today card's options import the practice pack and start stage 2. A stage-2 session holds four single shapes, then a colour combination, a value scale, a box to complete and an ellipse (S84). I pass the shapes with Next.

The combination: its picture lies in the left frame, bands or patches or blocks of related colours, soft or hard edged, one contrasting, some low in saturation; the empty frame beside it. The first time, its instructions show by themselves: copy by eye, squint for the overall tone and cover the frame with Fill frame first, then the big areas by colour with Big, then the smaller areas and edges with Small and Soft; keep weak contrasts weak. The tools beside the frame: the wheel, Fill frame with Undo and Redo, the pens Big, Small and Soft and the eyedropper (my own copy may be picked; the original refuses until Compare).

Copy: I pick a dark olive on the wheel and tap Fill frame (the tone); then the top band's green and two strokes of Big, the darker band almost black (too dark: the weak contrast made strong), the bottom band's blue grey. Undo takes the last stroke back, Redo returns it.

Compare: the original lies over my copy in place at half strength; the slider Original shown sets how much. The card shows a chip per area (the original's colour over mine) and the chosen area's two colours on the wheel with the arrows from mine to the original and in the colour table (ΔE 3.7; lightness −3.7 the longest bar, to the dark end: mine is darker; chroma and hue near nothing); its outline is drawn on both frames. On my copy the edge between the two dark bands is red: the weak contrast I made strong (the instructions say what the red means; the card does not repeat it). The darkest area, near black in both, still shows its hue apart, on the wheel's ring and in the table. Tapping another chip shows that area; the slider at full shows the original alone. With the eyedropper I touch a point of the original: both colours there show on the wheel and in the table, rings mark the point on both frames, and the colour is picked.

Value scale: a row of cells, the given dark and light at the ends (and as two halves in the original's frame); the first cell between them is in hand. A pen landing on an end is refused with a notice. I pick a value in the wheel's square (moving only up and down) and tap Fill cell; the next cell comes in hand; I make the middle one too dark. Compare: the original's frame shows the even scale; under my row a bar per cell as high as its value, the even step a red tick, the off cell's bar outlined red; the card holds only its title: the bars say which cell is off and which way. I pick a lighter value and paint over that cell with Big (the pen landing in it takes it in hand); Compare again: every cell even, in order.
Chinese: All tools, Actions, 中文: the card reads 明度推移; the summary in Chinese counts 色彩组合 and 明度推移 beside the shapes, boxes and ellipses, with their means (色块 ΔE, 弱对比画强, 偏离均匀, 顺序反了).

The long project: back in the gallery the Today card still reads stage 2, one session done. Its options list 色彩临摹（大作业）with 新建临摹…; tapped, a picker shows the pack's pictures by tier with their credits (S83); under 难 I tap the lamp, and a copy begins: the picture in the left frame, an empty frame of its shape beside it, the full interface showing, the bar 'Colour copy 1 · How · Compare' with no Next: it never ends as a session does. Its instructions show by themselves (in Chinese, then English again).

Work: a stroke on the original is refused ('Draw in the empty frame'); I pick a brown in the colour panel, set the brush larger on the side bar and paint the lamp. Compare lays the original over my copy at half strength; the slider sets a quarter; with the eyedropper a point of the original shows both colours on the wheel and in the table.
Leave and reopen: Gallery; the Today card is unchanged (the copy counts in no session); the options list 'Colour copy 1' with the lamp small beside it; tapped, it reopens with my strokes.
Not here: renaming or deleting a copy and copies of my own pictures (s83-practice-polish); a copy's own versions.
